title: Wholesale Purchasing Agreement
note: Working draft for legal review. Bracketed items are business decisions still to be confirmed. Not legally approved.

p: This Wholesale Purchasing Agreement (the "Agreement") is between Sparkling Jewelry Inc. ("Sparkling") and the business identified above (the "Customer").

Wholesale accounts are available only to businesses that purchase for resale or for use in their trade. Sparkling may approve, limit, suspend or close an account at its discretion. Signing this Agreement does not by itself approve the Customer's account, credit terms or memo privileges.
Order requests, holds and quotes submitted through the website, by phone, email or messaging are requests only. An order is accepted when Sparkling confirms it in writing or ships the goods.
Sparkling may decline or partially fill any order. Holds placed at the Customer's request are released after [hold period] unless extended in writing.
Inventory shown online changes frequently and is subject to prior sale. Prices are wholesale prices for the approved account and may change without notice until an order is confirmed.
The price confirmed for an accepted order applies to that order. Obvious pricing or listing errors may be corrected before shipment.
Unless approved credit terms apply, payment is due before shipment by the payment methods Sparkling accepts.
Amounts not paid when due may be subject to a late charge of [late charge rate], not to exceed the maximum permitted by law, plus reasonable collection costs.
Credit terms, if any, are offered only by separate written approval and may require a Credit Agreement and a Personal Guaranty. Sparkling may change or withdraw credit terms at any time.
If the Customer fails to pay when due, Sparkling may suspend shipments, require prepayment and declare all outstanding balances immediately due.
Special orders and custom pieces are made to the Customer's specifications and may require a deposit of [deposit amount].
Confirmed special and custom orders cannot be cancelled or returned except as stated in the order confirmation.

sections.h: Shipping, Insurance, Risk of Loss and Inspection
p: Goods ship by the method confirmed for the order. Shipping and insurance charges are the Customer's responsibility unless stated otherwise.

Risk of loss passes to the Customer [when goods are delivered to the carrier / on delivery]. The Customer must inspect each shipment and report any shortage, damage or discrepancy within [inspection period] of delivery.
Returns require prior written authorization and must be received within [return period] in original condition with all certificates and documentation.
Returns may be subject to a restocking fee of [restocking fee]. Special orders, custom pieces and altered goods are not returnable.
Goods released on memo remain Sparkling's property until paid in full. Memo transactions are governed by a separate Memo Agreement and the terms on each memo.
The Customer is responsible for memo goods while in its possession and must return or pay for them by the memo due date.

sections.h: Product Specifications and Lab-Grown Diamond Disclosures
p: Diamonds sold by Sparkling are laboratory-grown unless clearly stated otherwise. Grading reports are issued by independent laboratories and reflect the laboratory's opinion.
The Customer agrees to disclose to its own customers that lab-grown diamonds are laboratory-grown and to follow applicable advertising and disclosure rules.
The Customer must provide a valid resale or exemption certificate to purchase without sales tax. Without one, applicable taxes will be charged.
The Customer is responsible for any tax, duty or fee that applies to its purchases.
The Customer is responsible for keeping its login credentials secure and for orders placed through its account by its authorized users.
The Customer must notify Sparkling promptly of any unauthorized use of its account.
A default includes non-payment, breach of this Agreement, insolvency or providing materially false information.
On default, Sparkling may suspend or close the account, recover memo goods, and pursue amounts owed together with reasonable collection costs and attorneys' fees where permitted by law.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of [California], without regard to conflict-of-law rules.
Disputes will be resolved [in the state or federal courts located in Los Angeles County, California / by binding arbitration], unless the parties agree otherwise in writing.
The parties agree that this Agreement may be signed electronically and that electronic signatures and records have the same effect as paper originals.
The Customer may request a copy of this Agreement at any time from its account.
The person signing below confirms that they are authorized to sign this Agreement on behalf of the Customer and to bind the Customer to its terms.
This Agreement takes effect when signed by the Customer and accepted by Sparkling. Changes to the Customer's legal details after signing may require a new signed Agreement.
